name.km: អាម៉ុកសាច់គោ

description: Cambodia's signature dish — a silky coconut kroeung mousse steamed in banana leaf.
descriptionKm: ការីអាម៉ុក — ការីចំហុយក្នុងស្លឹកចេក ផ្សំទឹកដូងនិងគ្រឿងលឿង។

instructions.text: Pound the red kroeung to a very smooth paste — smoothness is everything in amok.
Prepare the beef: sliced thin against the grain.
instructions.textKm: រៀបចំសាច់គោ៖ ហាន់ស្ដើងបញ្ច្រាសខ្សែ។

instructions.text: In a bowl, whisk the kroeung with coconut milk, egg, fish sauce and palm sugar until thick and creamy.
instructions.tip: Add the coconut milk a little at a time so the mixture emulsifies.

instructions.text: Fold in the beef until well coated.
Line banana-leaf cups with a soft leaf, spoon in the mixture and top with coconut cream.
Steam over medium heat 20–25 minutes until set like a soft custard.
Garnish with coconut cream and shredded kaffir lime leaf; serve with rice.
